en.headline: Huanggang Port expected to handle 200,000 daily crossings initially, immigration chief…
en.dek: Director of Immigration Benson Kwok said nearly 200 retired staff have been rehired and personnel will be redeployed from quieter control points to support the new facility.
body: Director of Immigration Benson Kwok said the new Huanggang Port is expected to handle about 200,000 passenger trips a day in its initial phase after opening. Speaking on a television programme on Sunday, he noted that the department has rehired nearly 200 retired officers under post-retirement service contracts and will redeploy staff from other control points as needed.

Kwok said last year’s total passenger traffic through all control points reached a record 335 million. The new port will adopt a co-location “co-inspection, one-stop clearance” mode with 134 automated lanes, allowing travellers to complete both Hong Kong and mainland formalities in roughly five minutes instead of the previous 30 minutes involving a shuttle bus.

Once the Northern Link railway opens, daily capacity at the port could rise to around 300,000 trips. He expected passengers currently using Heung Yuen Wai and Lok Ma Chau Spur Line control points to be among those most likely to switch to the new facility.

zh.headline: 郭俊峯：新皇崗口岸初期料每日應付20萬人次
zh.dek: 入境處長表示已重聘近200名退休人員，並會從客流較少口岸調配人手支援新口岸運作。
body: 入境處處長郭俊峯周日在電視節目表示，新皇崗口岸啟用後初期預計每日可應付約20萬出入境人次。處方已透過退休後服務合約計劃重聘近200名退休同事，並會視乎需要從其他口岸調配人手。
他指去年全港出入境總人次達3.35億創歷史新高。新口岸將採用「合作查驗、一次放行」模式，設134條自助通道，旅客完成兩地手續時間可由以往約30分鐘大幅縮短至約5分鐘。
待港鐵北環綫開通後，口岸每日處理能力可提升至約30萬人次。他預期目前使用香園圍及落馬洲支線管制站的旅客，日後最有潛力轉用新皇崗口岸。
